data.heading: Larkspur Supply Co. opens the region's first gear library

data.html:
For immediate release. Port Wren, 14 October 2026.

Members can borrow tents, stoves, and snowshoes for free, starting 1 November 2026.

Port Wren — Larkspur Supply Co. will open a gear library on 1 November 2026. Members can borrow up to three items for a week at no cost. The library starts with 240 items donated by members and repaired in the co-op's workshop.

data.quote: Most gear spends its life in a closet. A library puts it back on the trail.
data.author: Priya Raman, general manager

data.html:
The library will be open during store hours at 214 Alder Street.

About Larkspur Supply Co.: Founded in 1987, the cooperative is owned by 9,400 members and sells, rents, and repairs outdoor equipment.

Media contact: Sam Whitlock, press@larkspur.coop, (360) 555-0177.
